title: A Symbolic Differentiation_Summation Framework for Power Sums of Arithmetic Sequences
summary: We give a self-contained derivation of the closed form of the power sums $S_m(n)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(a_0+(i-1)d)^m$ in which the Bernoulli numbers enter as constants of integration rather than as prescribed coefficients. The derivation rests on an elementary fact: a sum whose terms are polynomial in the index is the restriction to the integers of a unique polynomial, which satisfies the defining difference equation identically and may therefore be differentiated and integrated exactly. Differentiating lowers the power by one; integrating back introduces a single constant, equal to the slope…
